question: Radha has ₹10 and ₹5 coins. She has a total of 15 coins worth ₹85. How many coins of ₹5 does she have?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume all coins are ₹5 ⇒ total = 15 × 5 = 75

Extra needed = 85 − 75 = 10

Each ₹10 coin gives extra ₹5

Number of ₹10 coins = 10 ÷ 5 = 2

₹5 coins = 15 − 2 = 13

**∴ Answer = 13**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total coins = 15, Total value = 85

Coins are of ₹10 and ₹5

**Formula used:**

Form linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let number of ₹10 coins = x

⇒ Number of ₹5 coins = 15 − x

⇒ Total value = 10x + 5(15 − x)

⇒ 10x + 75 − 5x = 85

⇒ 5x = 10

⇒ x = 2

⇒ ₹5 coins = 15 − 2 = 13

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Type Logic

Assume all items as one type, then adjust using difference method.

Linear Equation Method

Use variables to form equations based on total number and value.

Check Method

Verify by substituting values back into total sum.
